title: Mail: allow identical server-set values, {} no-op
description: Canonical template (AGENTS.md: mail first). jmap-mail-server sieve.rs:686, mailbox.rs:887, mdn.rs:535, email.rs:1360, identity.rs:382, submission.rs:726 call reject_read_only_patch(.., None) and so reject identical server-set values. Fix as chat-server check_read_only_patch (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/helpers.rs, a22b574a): fetch stored object only when a read-only key is present, drop identical values. If a shared helper belongs in crate-jmap-server, put it there and switch chat-server to it. Mark's decision (on JMAP-t8ej.25 notes): an empty patch {} — literal, or empty after dropping identical server-set values — SUCCEEDS as a no-op: updated {id: null}, no write, state unchanged. RFC 8620 §5.3: server-set properties MAY be in the patch if identical to the current value, else invalidProperties. Make every mail /set update path treat {} as no-op success. One test per handler; oracle the §5.3 text.
